turn.user_message: Who has to agree to this?
turn.context: Playbook §4, key people: narrowed to the roles this talk touched, tied to what the hospital said.

text: Nine teams are touched, but only one approves the flow. Your Head of Operations signs off the new order of work, not the daily tasks.
Doctors matter most. You said they do not use voice notes, so the trial asks them for one tap, not a new habit.
chat.pointer: Filter the board, or pick a name badge to see what changes for that person.
chat.invite: Next, we can walk through each change on the ward.
chat.note: Help with each job first. Fewer hours come later.
prompts: What changes on the ward, step by step?
How do we win over the doctors?
Do we need to hire anyone?

blocks.title: Who has to say yes
blocks.deck: Grouped by what they do. Each badge shows what changes for them and what they gain.

blocks.rule: Tojo comes in as help with each job, not a threat to it. Any fall in staff hours comes later, once it is trusted.

people.name: Head of Operations
people.change: Signs off the new order of work across departments. Takes no part in the daily tasks.
people.gain: One Discharge Manager reports the numbers every week.

people.name: Doctors
people.change: Mark likely discharges on the evening round with one tap. Sign the early summary.
people.gain: The summary is ready to check, not to write.
people.said: “Our doctors don’t use voice notes right now.” So the trial uses a tap, not voice.

people.name: Nurses
people.change: Record the ready and leaving times. Start the papers after the evening round.
people.gain: No rush for medicines and papers at noon.

people.name: Billing
people.change: Checks a bill kept up to date all stay, instead of building it at the end.
people.gain: No pile of bills at noon.

people.name: Insurance desk
people.change: Sends the early request the evening before.
people.gain: Fewer calls chasing the insurer the next day.

people.name: Housekeeping
people.change: Hears the moment a patient leaves, with the bed number.
people.gain: No waiting for a phone call.

people.name: Pharmacy and diet
people.change: Told that evening who goes home tomorrow.
people.gain: Medicines packed before the morning rush.

people.name: Bed desk
people.change: Sees each bed turn ready without a call.
people.gain: The next patient is placed sooner.

people.name: IT team
people.change: Lets Tojo read the hospital software. Nothing can be changed or deleted.
people.gain: One clear list, asked for once.
